Is this the imposter from Among Us?|[[Commander/Gallery#Commander Dialogue|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 1 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ == Description == The '''Imposter''' is a joke [[Enemies|enemy]] that can only be spawned through its [[Logbooks|Logbook]], which can only be obtained if spawned by a developer while they are admin abusing. It was originally added as part of April Fools' Day 2021 and was exclusive to [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Only one '''Imposter''' spawned per entrance on [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, which is at the start of wave 1. It was later re-added on 6th of March 2024 as a commands only enemy, and would remain that way until 2025 where due to [[Logbooks]], it would be possible to obtain it for [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. The '''Imposter''' has extremely high health and speed for its debut during April Fools' Day 2021, being much faster than the [[Fallen Rusher (Legacy)|Fallen Rusher]]. ==Appearance== The '''Imposter''' has red skin with a black outline (to mimic a cartoon style), and a blue visor. It has a fast wobbling animation as it ran. ==April Fools Strategy== As this enemy only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the [[Overhaul v1.2|April Fools 2021]] update is listed. *Towers that rely on units, such as the [[Military Base]] are ineffective, as the '''Imposter''' will pass through the units. *High DPS towers for early game are necessary to kill the '''Imposter'''. ** Towers such as the [[Scout|{{Color|Golden}} Scout]] and [[Soldier|{{Color|Golden}} Soldier]] are highly recommended. **You can also use towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Freezer]] to give your towers more time to attack it. *The '''Imposter''' is not hidden (despite being a Ghost enemy), so hidden detection is not required. *The best map to defeat the '''Imposter''' in is [[Polluted Wasteland]] as it crosses the middle multiple times. **Outside of [[Polluted Wasteland]], it is unlikely that you will be able to kill the '''Imposter'''. Therefore, you can use the [[Medic]] to heal back your base health. ***This makes using [[Farm]]s less viable as you have less base health to sacrifice. **Unless you have over 198 base health or deal enough damage to the '''Imposters''' where you do not lose all your base health, dual lane maps, such as [[Winter Stronghold]], are impossible to beat on [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, as two '''Imposters''' would spawn at the beginning of Wave 1. ==Badge== {{Badge |title = Suspicious... |description = When the imposter is SUS! You have 1 minute... |rewards = {{Exp|150}} |image = AprilFoolsBadgeSus.png |obtainable = No }} ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 ImposterIconIG.png|'''Imposter''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Despite originally being a ghost enemy, towers without hidden detection could still target and attack the '''Imposter''' as it is not a hidden enemy. **This made '''Imposter''' the first ghost enemy to not also be a hidden enemy. *The '''Imposter''' is the fastest enemy in the game. *The '''Imposter''' is a reference to the game ''[[w:c:among-us:Among_Us|Among Us]]''. *When the '''Imposter''' spawns and dies, it plays a unique sound effect. **The former sound is taken from ''Among Us'' itself, being the death sound to indicate that you have been murdered. **The latter sound is an audio clip from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zn2v_kHkyis Yelling "among us" sound effect]. *The [[Commander]] dialogue is a reference to the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G19FCaZzJsQ Hello is this the Imposter from Among Us?] YouTube meme. **The misspelt ''Among Us'' as ''Amogus'' is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/amogus Amogus] meme. *Killing the '''Imposter''' awarded the ''Suspicious...'' badge. **Originally, it had a requirement of one minute, which was the time until the first wave ends. **The ''When the imposter is SUS!'' in the badge description is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/when-the-imposter-is-sus-sus-jerma When the imposter is sus!] meme. *The '''Imposter''' may have been based on the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Golden Zombie|Golden Zombie]] from ''Tower Battles''. *Initially, the '''Imposter''' would get stuck running on the first bridge of [[Autumn Falling]] due to a glitch, making it easy to kill. **This was patched soon after the '''Imposter''' was added, rendering the strategy useless. *The word ''Imposter'' is more commonly known (and spelt) as ''Impostor''. **However, both variants of the word are correct and the game referred to this enemy as the '''Imposter'''. *Despite no longer naturally appearing in the game, the '''Imposter''' could appear as an enemy for the [[Quests#Kill ENEMY!|Kill ''ENEMY''!]] quest between the 6th of March 2024 and 8th of March 2024. As it has 99 health, the number of kills required is 101. **Additionally, it was not the only enemy that did not currently appear in the game to appear in this quest during that period. There was also an enemy called the [[Arrow]], with a requirement of one kill. However, this enemy had never actually appeared anywhere in the game at the time, unlike the '''Imposter'''. ***The [[Arrow]] would later appear in [[Headache Headquarters]], however, its health would be heavily reduced, as it previously had nine billion health. The [[Imposter]] would not make an appearance. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.2|Overhaul v1.2.0]] **'''Imposter''' added. *'''2 April 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.2|Overhaul v1.2.0b]] **'''Imposter''' removed. *'''6 March 2024''' - [[v1.14.0]]c **'''Imposter''' re-added as a commands-only enemy. **No longer is a ghost enemy. **No longer gives a badge upon death. *'''13 March 2024''' - [[v1.15.0]]d **Now gives a badge upon death. *'''30 October 2025''' **'''Imposter''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only if the player obtained its [[Logbooks|Logbook]] whenever developers spawned it in. {{LegacyFallen|Start|N/A|Imposter & [[Abnormal]]|Wave 1|[[Quick]]|Wave 5|date = 1 April 2021 – 2 April 2021}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
